snippet.title: Tyrants Rafting - Two Dictators, One Boat | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY ON ITCH.IO - https://victormacky.itch.io/tyrants-rafting

Two dictators. One boat. Zero control.

Tyrants Rafting is a hard physics rage game where you steer two tyrants down a river packed with traps. Press A to go left, D to go right, and both together to go forward. The controls are hard on purpose, and your fingers will not survive.

Dodge drones, naval mines, electric fence corners, helicopter blades, minefields and exploding oil barrels while your own boat is rigged with bomb timers. Make it to the end and escape as tyrants.

If you like chaotic rage games like Chained Together, BeamNG.drive, Super Battle Golf or Only Up, this one is for you.

GAME FEATURES
- Intentionally hard two-key steering (A, D, or both)
- Play a bunch of dictators with their own voice lines
- Tight, trap-filled routes where one mistake ends the run
- A special speedboat and pickup trucks with guns
- Bomb timers rigged to your boat
- Pure physics chaos that is nearly impossible to finish

Can you escape as tyrants? Tell us how far you got in the comments.

#ragegame #physicsgame #indiegame #chainedtogether #beamngdrive #onlyup #hardgame #gamedev
